# Title
Setup Spring Boot project structure

## Description
As a developer, I want a clean, modular Spring Boot application structure so that it’s easy to extend and maintain the backend.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The project compiles with `mvn clean install`.
- Packages are logically separated into `controller`, `service`, `repository`, `model`, and `config`.
- Application connects to an in-memory H2 database on startup.

## Definition of Done
- The application runs successfully on `localhost:8080`.
- Proper `.gitignore`, `pom.xml` dependencies, and `application.yml` are configured.
- Code is committed to the repository without compilation errors.

## Subtasks
- Initialize Spring Boot project.
- Configure H2 in-memory database.
- Add JPA, Web, and Lombok dependencies.
- Create example controller `/api/hello`.
